name: Artificer's Lore
says: On Intelligence (History) checks about magic items, alchemical objects or technological devices, add twice the proficiency bonus instead of any proficiency bonus normally applied.
does: A tagged proficiency effect (History, expertise, tags about:*) only makes a hint with the whole bonus (Int mod + 2x proficiency, replacing a normal History proficiency); no roll adds it, and the master decides when it applies.
seen: Lembretes on the sheet: 'História +8 sobre itens mágicos, objetos alquímicos ou engenhocas.' (+8 for a level 5 rock gnome wizard, Int 15).

name: Brave
says: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
does: roll_mode advantage on save.all tagged against:frightened becomes a tagged save; combat gives the advantage when the save's source is known (Fear, Phantasmal Killer, Weird, an effect or trap that gives the frightened condition); a save asked with no source (master-asked, concentration) keeps only the sheet reminder.
seen: Lembretes: 'Vantagem em testes de resistência contra ficar amedrontado.'

name: Breath Weapon
says: Action to exhale: each creature in the area saves (type by ancestry) against DC 8 + Con mod + proficiency, takes 2d6 (3d6 at 6, 4d6 at 11, 5d6 at 16) or half on a save; usable again after a short or long rest.
does: Numbers are right (DC, dice by total level, shape and size and save by colour, checked at levels 1 to 20 for all ten colours); the grant_action spends the action and the one use, which a short or long rest restores. The app rolls no damage and no saves and draws no area: the table does it by hand.
seen: Combat column panel 'Arma de sopro' with the paragraph (dice, type, area, save, DC, growth, half on success, 1 use per rest) and a Lembretes line 'Arma de Sopro: CD 12; causa 2d6 ... metade se o alvo passar'; the action card in combat spends the action and the use.
code: backend/internal/rules/choiceeffects.go breathWeapon, breathWeaponText; backend/internal/rules/rest.go RestRecovery; backend/internal/play/combat_take_action.go performFeature; backend/internal/rules/srd51/effects/races.json, choices.json
fix: A handler like Turn Undead or Second Wind for key trait:breath-weapon that rolls the dice and asks each target in the area the save against the DC (or a feature use with targets and half damage on success).

name: Damage Resistance
says: Resistance to the damage type of the draconic ancestry.
does: The picked ancestry trait gives a resistance (damage_resistances.json) that Content.Resistances hands to combat, which halves that damage type; the sheet lists it. The trait row itself carries a bare note.
seen: Sheet Resistências pill (e.g. fogo) and the breath paragraph ends 'Resistência a dano de fogo'.

name: Darkvision
says: See in dim light within 60 ft as bright light, and in darkness as dim light (grey only).
does: A sense effect darkvision 60 ft (all six races checked) feeds the fog of war: within range dim light is seen as bright, darkness is seen grey, it does not work in magical Darkness; also lets a character not be in the dark for the master's warning.
seen: On a fog map the player sees those squares lit or grey; the sheet lists 'Visão no escuro 60'.
